⚠️ The verdict is **fix**: the rebuilt Inbox itself was never photographed. The only shots are of the `/framework/ux/` and `/framework/ux/Browse/` doc pages, so nothing shows the list taking a third of the screen at 1920, Waiting on you at the top, or the phone screen.

The report is in `inbox-browse/review/report.md`. It has two other fixes:
- **The class list is cut off** on [Browse](/framework/ux/Browse/) at all four widths: the comment column of the code block stops mid-word.
- **The page has no live demo**: it is two markdown files and a link, even though its readme promises "then the demo".

Five smaller notes are in the file, including 114 lines in Waiting on you, and a missing file (404) logged on every shot.
